glossary.name: Avengers
glossary.summary: A Hero team. In the core box its members are Black Widow, Captain America, Hawkeye, Hulk, Iron Man and Thor.
glossary.box: Marvel Legendary First Edition core box

glossary.name: X-Men
glossary.summary: A Hero team. In the core box its members are Cyclops, Emma Frost, Gambit, Rogue, Storm and Wolverine.
glossary.box: Marvel Legendary First Edition core box

glossary.name: Guardians of the Galaxy
glossary.summary: A Hero team. In this box its members are Drax the Destroyer, Gamora, Groot, Rocket Raccoon and Star-Lord.

glossary.name: Covert
glossary.summary: A Hero class of fighters who prefer trickery and careful plans to open force.
glossary.box: Marvel Legendary First Edition core box

glossary.name: Instinct
glossary.summary: A Hero class of fighters who trust their gut and their senses in close combat.
glossary.box: Marvel Legendary First Edition core box

glossary.name: Ranged
glossary.summary: A Hero class of fighters who deal damage from a distance, by any kind of projected power.
glossary.box: Marvel Legendary First Edition core box

glossary.name: Strength
glossary.summary: A Hero class of fighters whose power is might, whether of body or of will and leadership.
glossary.box: Marvel Legendary First Edition core box

glossary.name: Tech
glossary.summary: A Hero class of fighters whose power comes from gear and science rather than the body.
glossary.box: Marvel Legendary First Edition core box

glossary.name: Always Leads
glossary.summary: Names the one Villain or Henchman Group this Mastermind brings to every game. That group takes one of the setup's group slots; random draws fill the rest.
glossary.box: Marvel Legendary First Edition core box

glossary.name: Ambush
glossary.summary: Triggers as this Villain arrives in the city from the Villain Deck. When its arrival shoves another Villain out of the city, resolve that escape before this effect.
glossary.box: Marvel Legendary First Edition core box

glossary.name: Fight
glossary.summary: Triggers when a player spends enough Attack to defeat this card.
glossary.box: Marvel Legendary First Edition core box

glossary.name: Master Strike
glossary.summary: Drawing a Master Strike from the Villain Deck makes the Mastermind act in person: resolve the Master Strike line on its card. The Strike card is then KO'd.
glossary.box: Marvel Legendary First Edition core box

glossary.name: Mastermind Tactic
glossary.summary: Beating the Mastermind's Attack wins one of its four face-down Tactics at random: keep it for Victory Points and do its Fight effect. Take all four to win.
glossary.box: Marvel Legendary First Edition core box

glossary.name: Rescue a Bystander
glossary.summary: Add a Bystander from the shared Bystander stack to your Victory Pile, where it scores at game end. This never frees a Bystander a Villain holds; defeat that Villain for it.
glossary.box: Marvel Legendary First Edition core box

glossary.name: Scheme Twist
glossary.summary: Drawing a Twist from the Villain Deck advances the evil plan: resolve the Twist line on the Scheme card. The Twist is then KO'd, unless the Scheme sends it elsewhere.
glossary.box: Marvel Legendary First Edition core box

glossary.name: Shard
glossary.summary: A token from a shared supply. Return one to the supply for +1 Attack, now or on a later turn; each Shard sitting on a Villain or Mastermind adds 1 to its Attack.

glossary.name: Artifact
glossary.summary: A card you put in front of you when you play it. It stays there between turns, and you can usually use its ability once on each of your turns.
